name: Ushio Minami
source:
Area: Yamaguchi Prefecture

A girl who works as the poster girl of a puffer fish restaurant, she is quite passionate about the said fish as well. When she was younger her parents divorced and her father took Minami with him. As his health started declining, Minami had to start working in order to support both of them. She also sometimes wonders whether it's alright for a girl like her to work for a fine cuisine restaurant.
